title: Pride and Prejudice
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy must reconsider their first impressions as family pressures shape their choices.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
description: Dr. Watson records twelve cases that take Sherlock Holmes from London drawing rooms to the English countryside.

title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
description: Alice follows a white rabbit underground and meets a cast of creatures whose rules make sense only to themselves.

title: Frankenstein
description: The scientist Victor Frankenstein brings a creature to life and faces the consequences of leaving him to fend for himself.

title: Dracula
description: A group of friends assemble journals, letters, and records to track a mysterious count from Transylvania.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
description: Dorian Gray stays young while his painted likeness bears the marks of the life he chooses to lead.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
description: Dorothy and her new companions follow the yellow brick road, hoping the Wizard can help each of them.

title: Little Women
description: The four March sisters grow up in Civil War-era New England, with ambitions as different as their temperaments.

title: The Time Machine
description: A Victorian inventor travels into the distant future and wonders what became of the society he left behind.

title: Treasure Island
description: Jim Hawkins ventures to sea with a treasure map and learns that Long John Silver has plans of his own.

title: The Yellow Wallpaper
description: Confined to a room for a rest cure, a woman begins to see movement behind the pattern on its walls.

title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
description: Captain Hastings visits Styles Court, where a death introduces him to Hercule Poirot’s methods of investigation.
